title: Microsoft Edge: vertical tabs update
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts and existing vertical-tabs policy match Microsoft's sources, including the Group Policy path and registry setting. It appropriately leaves update-specific defaults, licensing, charges and rollout details unresolved.

claims.claim: The registry control is SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge, value VerticalTabsAllowed, type REG_DWORD.
claims.quote:
Registry settings
Path (Mandatory): SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge
Value name: VerticalTabsAllowed
Value type: REG\_DWORD

claims.claim: VerticalTabsAllowed governs whether users can access the vertical tab layout.
claims.quote: Configures whether a user can access an alternative layout where tabs are vertically aligned on the side of the browser instead of at the top.
